items.answer_en: In San Diego County, your November 3 mail ballot packet includes an "I Voted" sticker, along with voting instructions and a two-card ballot.
items.quote: The official ballot packet will include voting instructions, a two-card ballot and an “I Voted” sticker.
items.host_label: the County of San Diego (County News Center, for the Registrar of Voters)
items.notes: Posted Oct. 2, 2026 by the County of San Diego Communications Office. Host is the county's own news site; sdvote.com home page has no sticker text.

items.host_label: the Santa Clara County Registrar of Voters
items.notes: Cloudflare 403 to curl and WebFetch; /2026 page not in Wayback. The archived April 2026 contest page (/get-involved/i-voted-sticker-contest) says winners become the sticker for the Nov 3, 2026 election but says nothing about mail packets. Orange County's mail-packet page (ocvote.gov) is from 2016, too old.

items.answer_en: In Clay County, the winning design from the county's sticker contest is handed out during early voting and on Election Day for the 2026 primary and general elections.
items.quote: One original sticker design will be chosen and reproduced for distribution during Early Voting and Election Day for both the Primary and General Elections in 2026.
items.host_label: the Clay County Supervisor of Elections

items.answer_en: In Seminole County, a student-designed "I Voted" sticker is given to voters at early voting sites and polling places during the 2026 elections.
items.quote: One winning design will be selected and reproduced as the official 2-inch round “I Voted” stickers to be given to voters at polling places and early voting sites.
items.host_label: the Seminole County Supervisor of Elections
items.notes: Release dated January 28, 2026; says the sticker is for the 2026 Election Cycle. Alternate to Clay; use one.

items.answer_en: In New York City, early voting runs October 24 to November 1, and the city's 2026 general election guide tells poll-site voters to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before leaving.
items.quote: Don't forget to pick up an official "I Voted" sticker before you leave!
items.notes: The page is titled 2026 General Election; the sticker line is in 'How to Vote at a Poll Site', which covers early voting (Oct 24 to Nov 1) and Election Day. Issued by the City, not the NYC Board of Elections.

items.answer_en: In Multnomah County, sign up for ballot tracking at BallotTrax and you get a virtual "I Voted" sticker to share online.
items.quote: You'll even receive a virtual "I Voted" sticker that's ready to share on social media.
items.notes: Oct 22, 2026 county news item; sentence follows the BallotTrax sign-up instructions.

items.answer_en: Deschutes County's November sticker, designed by a Mountain View High School student, is available in November. For the May primary, the county offered its sticker at the County Clerk's office and city halls.
items.quote: Rowan's "I Voted" sticker will be available in November.
items.notes: Page does not say where the November sticker is handed out. Preceding sentence (primary): "Bodhi's "I Voted" sticker will be available to pick up at our office and city halls from May 1 to Election Day." Old URL /clerk/page/... now 404s.

items.answer_en: In the City of Roanoke, limited America 250 "I Voted" stickers are handed out during early voting at the Office of Voter Registration and Elections and at precincts on Election Day.
items.quote: Limited quantities of America 250 “I Voted” stickers will be distributed during early voting and at each precinct on Election Day.
items.notes: Posted Sept 15, 2026 ('Important November Election Deadlines'). Direct fetch 403 (CivicPlus); read via web.archive.org copy. Early voting at 317 Kimball Ave. NE, Sept 18 to Oct 31.

items.answer_en: In the City of Northville, your absentee ballot comes with voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker.
items.quote: Your ballot comes with complete voting instructions and an "I Voted" sticker.
items.notes: Undated FAQ, Absent Voter Ballots (Vote by Mail) section; live page checked 2026-10-23. Year is 'current', not an explicit 2026 statement.

items.answer_en: Georgia's new 2026 sticker went to all 159 counties, and voters can get it starting with early voting, which began October 13.
items.quote: Voters can get the stickers when early voting starts on October 13.
items.notes: State program, not a county one; the existing tradition text already cites this page. Direct fetch 403; read via web.archive.org copy.

items.answer_en: In Cochise County, early ballot packets for the 2026 primary included a county sticker; a printing error sent a few voters Yuma County's "I Voted Early" sticker instead.
items.quote: A very small group of voters received a Yuma County "I Voted Early" sticker instead of the appropriate Cochise County sticker in the ballot packet they received.
items.host_label: the Cochise County Recorder's Office and Elections Department
items.notes: June 30, 2026 notice about the primary. Shows Cochise and Yuma packets carried stickers in 2026; does not confirm the November packets. Read with WebFetch (curl 403); quote as returned by WebFetch, verify once in a browser. Pima's sticker page is 2022 content.

items.answer_en: In Clark County, the 2026 general election guide's in-person voting steps end with "Receive your 'I Voted' sticker," and they apply at early voting sites October 17 to 30.
items.quote: Receive your “I Voted” sticker.
items.notes: 2026 General Election Guide PDF, page 9 voting instructions (vote card, ballot marking device, tabulator), used at all voting sites.

items.answer_en: Clark County's 2026 mail ballot tips tell you not to stick the "I Voted" sticker on your ballot, so look for it in your mail ballot packet.
items.quote: Do not stick the “I Voted” sticker on your ballot.
items.notes: The tips imply the sticker is in the packet but never list packet contents. Answer wording 'look for it' is an inference; soften if QA requires an explicit statement.

items.answer_en: In Garfield County, a limited special edition "I Voted" sticker for the U.S. 250th and Colorado 150th anniversaries is available at ballot drop boxes and vote centers while supplies last.
items.quote: A limited special edition “I Voted” sticker honoring the 250th anniversary of the United States and the 150th anniversary of Colorado is available at ballot drop boxes and vote centers while supplies last.
items.host_label: the Garfield County Clerk and Recorder
items.notes: Dated October 6, 2026.

items.answer_en: In Garfield County, vote centers, open from October 19, have a limited special edition "I Voted" sticker while supplies last.
items.quote: A limited special edition “I Voted” sticker honoring the 250th anniversary of the United States and the 150th anniversary of Colorado is available at ballot drop boxes and vote centers while supplies last.
items.host_label: the Garfield County Clerk and Recorder
items.notes: Same sentence as the mail item; early voting centers open Oct 19 in Glenwood Springs and Rifle (same page).

items.answer_en: Douglas County printed its 2026 "I Voted" sticker on the voter instructions that came with the June primary mail ballot.
items.quote: The “I Voted” sticker is included on the voter instructions provided with your mail ballot.
items.notes: June 8, 2026 primary post. No general election post found.

items.answer_en: In Champaign County, the clerk's early voting steps end with taking an "I Voted" sticker after your ballot is cast.
items.quote: Take an "I Voted" sticker and you're done!
items.notes: Page lists 2026 General Election early voting sites and dates (Sept 24 to Nov 2).

items.answer_en: For the June 2026 primary, the State Election Board sent limited-edition America 250 "I Voted" stickers to early voting locations and polling places across Oklahoma.
items.quote: In honor of America’s 250th birthday, limited-edition ‘I Voted’ stickers will be available at early voting locations and polling places across the state, while supplies last.
items.notes: June 8, 2026 release for the June 16 primary; no November release found. State program, not a county one. Quote is the Secretary's words as given in the release.

items.answer_en: DC Board of Elections mail ballot packets for the June 2026 primary listed an "I Voted" sticker among the contents.
items.quote: 1. Check that you have all the contents of your Mail Ballot Packet.
items.notes: Instruction sheet for the June 16, 2026 primary (file dated 4/6/2026). The list under step 1 includes the item "An “I Voted” Sticker" (a list item, not a sentence). No November version found.

items.answer_en: In Snohomish County, after you return your ballot you can pick up one of seven "I Voted" sticker designs at the Auditor's Office in Everett, any Sno-Isle Libraries location, or an accessible voter services site during open hours.
items.quote: After returning their completed ballots, voters can celebrate their civic participation with one of Snohomish County’s new “I Voted” stickers, available at the Auditor’s Office in Everett, all Sno-Isle Libraries locations , and accessible voter services sites during their hours of operation.
items.notes: Posted Oct 7, 2026 (Ballots for November 3 Election Will Be Mailed to Voters on October 9). Quote keeps the page's stray space before the comma. King County's sticker-mailing release is July 2025, nothing for 2026 found.

items.answer_en: El Paso County hands out student-designed "I Voted" stickers, and its 2026 winners are the stickers for this year's elections.
items.quote: First place winning designs will be distributed to voters during the 2026 election season.
items.host_label: the El Paso County Elections Department
items.notes: Says 2026 election season, not early voting specifically. The page's older 2024 text said early voting locations and Election Day vote centers.

403 to curl and WebFetch (CivicPlus); winners page and newsflash 864 not in Wayback. A search snippet says winning stickers are available from the first day of early voting Oct 19 through Nov 3, 2026, unverified. Harris (astronaut sticker) has only news coverage; Dallas has only a 2024 contest page.

minnesota.finding: No official reconciliation found. Minn. Stat. 204B.49 (2025 Statutes) still says officials "may provide a sticker containing the words "I VOTED," and nothing more." Minneapolis's early voting page says: "Either way, you will leave with an ‘I Voted Early’ sticker." SF 4734 (introduced 03/23/2026, referred to the Senate Elections committee, no further action shown) would allow design contests but keeps the rule that a design "must only include the words "I VOTED," ... or include any other words or numbers." Neither the Secretary of State nor Minneapolis addresses the gap on any page found.

gaps.UT: Weber County page says its sticker goes 'to voters throughout the 2026 election cycle' (no early/mail detail): https://www.weberelections.gov/250sticker ; Grand/Salt Lake/Utah County only in news
